# install: investigate possibilities of gerhard/setup

Study [gerhard/setup](https://github.com/gerhard/setup), Gerhard Lazu's machine-setup repository. **Motivation:** it "looks exciting and has interesting techniques", e.g. opting out of individual casks by deleting marker files (`rm ~/.setup/homebrew/casks/{alfred,istat-menus}`), a `go/packages` directory as the declarative list of Go tools, and a `libconfig` library layout. To do: use [tart](https://github.com/cirruslabs/tart) for integration tests of whatever is adopted ([#399](DOT-397.md)).
